items.title: Mrs. Charlotte Botney and Mrs. Bertha George McCullum Interview, 1960-10-16

ctx.x: A cornet is a little harder to blow than a trumpet. Well, it's not getting moved. So it's not making a trumpet, but it's a little easier to blow. Didn't Lloyd Armstrong want to buy one of the, uh, George, Bill George's trumpet one time?
Yes, Bill Armstrong. Yes, he came in here with Bill George's. He wanted to buy a little George's, but somebody, he hadn't heard about it. See, he had a gold trumpet.
